source_boundary.truth_boundary: For f(x) = x^2 at the multiple root zero, nonzero Newton iterates satisfy x_(n+1) = x_n / 2 and converge linearly rather than quadratically. The classical update is undefined where f'(x_n) = 0. A nondegeneracy and iterate-well-definedness policy therefore cannot be omitted.
